description: Post-generation checks. Run every check; report all violations, not just the first.

checks.description: Mandatory documentation read order was followed
Every component used resolves to an entry in COMPONENTS_INDEX.json
Every import resolves to an approved path prefix
Every prop, variant and size exists in the component's .agent.json
No raw color or undocumented token name where a semantic token exists
Compound parts nested correctly; structural constraints satisfied
No rule in forbidden.json is triggered
WCAG 2.1 AA baseline: labels, focus order, keyboard, contrast, live regions, reduced motion
No new packages, no package.json or build config edits
ai:* components appear only on AI-native surfaces; ui:* carries everything else
Each ai:* component's declared accountability obligations are satisfied in the rendered output

gate.rule: Any critical violation fails the generation. High violations fail unless the user has explicitly accepted them. Medium and low are reported as warnings.
gate.onFail: Return the violation list and the corrected output. Do not return failing code as final.
